purpose: how many rows each candidate re-ranking actually moves at fixed K.  Publishes and GATES NOTHING; it exists so a wave does not spend a frozen review on an arm whose kept set is the sealed child's

SEALED.claim: symmetric_difference is how many rows this arm actually moved at fixed K.  If it is ZERO the arm IS the sealed child and a null says nothing about selection; the footrule is how far the arm's whole candidate ORDER is from the sealed one, which is nonzero even when the kept set is not
